about_the_game:
Infernity: The Devil's Arena

The Devil’s Arena Awaits You!

Welcome to the darkest corners of Hell. Infernity: The Devil’s Arena throws you into a war that doesn’t end, even after death. Gladiators who lost their lives in the real world are now bound to serve the Devil, doomed to fight endlessly in a hellish arena.

Face ruthless enemies in dark, gothic, dungeon-themed arenas. Survive, claim victory, and collect rewards. As the Devil watches you from his throne, your fate depends entirely on his whim. Sometimes you’ll be rewarded other times, punished with fresh waves of enemies.


Bloody and Dynamic Arenas

Fight in deadly arenas, each with its own dark theme and deadly traps. Use your strategy and make the most of advantageous positions.

Demonic Rewards & Punishments

Every glance at the Devil’s throne brings uncertainty. He may grant you a reward or unleash an army of skeletons upon you.


Create Your Own Gladiator

Customize your character’s appearance, level up your skills, and equip powerful weapons to dominate the battlefield.

Single Player & Local Co-op

Fight alone, or team up with a friend on the same screen. The game does not include online multiplayer.




Advanced Lobby System: Araf

Unlock new abilities, upgrade your stats, and buy new gear in the purgatory-themed hub called Araf. Prepare yourself thoroughly before stepping into the arena.

Lobby.gif

Progress with Skull Coins

Earn skull-engraved coins at the end of each battle. Use them to power up your character, unlock new arenas, and purchase stronger weapons to move closer to victory.

Level Up and Unlock Arenas

Gain XP after each match to unlock new arenas. As your level increases, the difficulty rises and even the audience becomes a crowd of skeletons.

Dark and Terrifying Atmosphere

The game’s visual style reflects the gothic and threatening aesthetic of Hell. Every corner hides a demonic danger.

Mana-Powered Abilities

Use special abilities during combat to gain an edge but be careful how you manage your mana!


Trap-Filled Arenas

Battlefields are filled with spiked traps and dangerous terrain. Stay alert, protect yourself, and lure your enemies into their doom.



Release Date & Roadmap

  • Add to Wishlist: Support the game ahead of its Steam release by adding it to your favorites!

  • Next Fest Participation (June): We’ll be featured in Steam Next Fest this June with exclusive content and surprises!

Add Infernity to your wishlist now and let the dark arena shape your fate.
Survive, entertain the Devil—and become the King of Hell!

content_descriptors.notes: Infernity: The Devil's Arena features fantasy and dark elements with combat and fighting mechanics. The game includes various fantastical creatures and characters, along with simplified blood effects during battles. The content is presented in a fictional and non-realistic setting.

  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Step into the depths of hell in Devil's Arena. Fight as a fallen gladiator in brutal, trap-filled arenas. Customize your warrior and unlock new arenas. Survive the chaos and fight for eternal victory or escape the torment of hell itself!

English*, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
